Question
========
What sentences apply to a write-back mechanism in a cache?


Answerlist
----------
* The content is written directly to memory
* The content is written directly to cache
* The advantage is that CPU does not have to wait for DDR to write
* Multiple writes to the same place need to flush the cache to DDR each time

Solution
========
With write-back the store lands in the cache and marks the line dirty. Memory is updated only when the line is finally evicted, so repeated writes to the same address cost a single memory write instead of one per store.

Answerlist
----------
* 0. That is write-through, the other policy.
* 1. The store updates the cache line and marks it dirty.
* 1. The slow memory write is deferred to the eviction.
* 0. This is exactly what write-back avoids; it is the drawback of write-through.
